note: Both sets correctly capture the core Energy Balance thresholds (full points ≥ 0 kWh, reduced points −50 to 0 kWh scaled linearly, no points ≤ −50 kWh), the 75% display brightness minimum, the 15-minute neighbor visits, four houses per neighborhood, and Rule 11-1 being suspended on movie night. Set A adds useful facts B omits (three scores per guest team per host team, 0 points at exactly −50 kWh), but it also invents a condition on the brightness rule ('showing supplied content'), states the no-points boundary as < −50 kWh instead of ≤ −50 kWh, and offers two claims whose quotes are bare axis numbers ('100', '0') that do not support the claim. Set B has only one real error (the same < −50 kWh boundary with a caption-only quote) plus one trivial axis-label claim, and it uniquely records the five neighborhoods and the three organizer-selected movies. Set B is more redundant overall, but its claims are more faithful and it misses fewer page facts.
